## `client.package_indexes`

The `package_indexes` resource of the platform API.

### `client.package_indexes.create`

Signature: `client.package_indexes.create(name: str, url: str, *, credential_secret: str | None = None) -> PackageIndex`

Register a package index (needs `MANAGE_PACKAGE_INDEX`).

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | required | Unique name; no dots, no control or format character, no line separator and no space at either end. |
| `url` | `str` | required | ``https://host/path`` of the index, without a user name or password. |
| `credential_secret` | `str | None` | `None` | Name of the secret that holds ``username`` and ``password``, per environment. |

Returns: `PackageIndex`. The registered index.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.Conflict` | If the name or the URL is taken. |
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If a field is invalid. |

### `client.package_indexes.list`
